rationale: A legitimate but incremental recombination of two archive parents (EV-yield gate × cash-flow-statement accrual leg) with a coherent hypothesis-to-expression mapping, though the ~0.09 coverage from `oancf` and the prior weak FMB slope of the CF-accrual leg under a B/M gate temper expectations that it will dominate both parents.

This is a one-operator denominator tweak (dropping `che`) of the archive's existing EVYieldGatedAccrualQuality with an otherwise identical accrual leg — a cosmetic robustness variant rather than a substantively different mechanism, and since RANK already neutralizes extreme-but-positive EV ratios the fix only matters for the small subset with negative enterprise value.

Another gate-swap recombination of archive legs, but the FMB-versus-alpha diagnostic motivating it is honest and specific; note the INDICATOR creates a large point mass at zero (all firms without a prior build-up), so the ZSCORE and resulting sort will be driven by a degenerate spike that should be checked for portfolio-composition instability.

The hypothesis is asymmetric (leverage makes an accrual *reversal* existential) but the expression multiplies symmetrically, so highly levered firms with income-*decreasing* accruals are scored as the most attractive long positions — an implication the reasoning never defends — and the product embeds a leverage main effect that is itself confounded with distress and value.

The argument that every gate tested so far has an accrual-contaminated numerator is a genuine and non-obvious critique, and a cash-distribution gate is economically distinct from the archive's book/earnings/EBITDA gates; the main risk is that `dvc`=0 for non-payers produces a large tied rank block that turns the composite into a scaled pure-accrual signal over half the cross-section, and that payers skew large-cap where the accrual effect is weakest.

The stock-versus-flow diagnostic is well-posed and the MIN double hurdle is a structurally new combiner rather than another deflator, but the two legs are mechanically related (the flow is essentially a difference of the stock) and MIN discards the magnitude of the passing leg, so it may simply inherit whichever component is noisier rather than combining their complementary strengths.
